result.summary: The page is generally well-formed, but one clear defect stands out: the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the exact same restaurant ('Green Bowl Poké') twice as the first and second cards, with identical image, delivery time, and delivery fee. No other layout, styling, or accessibility breakages are apparent.

issues.description: Duplicate restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel: 'Green Bowl Poké' (15–25 min, €0.90 delivery) appears twice consecutively with identical image and metadata, suggesting a data deduplication bug.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate carousel items by restaurant ID before rendering so each restaurant appears only once in the list.
